content.thinking: הכותרת על איפה להשקיע במדד הכי זול היא בדיוק התחום שלי, וה-S&P 500 כבר נבחר. אני רק צופה, כך שאני לא יכולה לשנות את הסכום שכאן, שהוא 86,492 ₪ לפי הבחירה הזולה.
The page had me pick "פסגות" with the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund, and I'm skipping the colourful tags I don't follow while I keep scrolling.

content.text: Long lists, all look the same. Getting tired. A quick look at what's left.
נטרול מט"ח — no idea, charts with minuses. Boring. One last flick to see if there's a "what to do now" at the bottom.

I'd go with פסגות for the account and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", which the page marks "הזול". It says I'd end up with about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That's only for the page's example, though: 10,000 ₪ up front, then 500 ₪ a month at 7% a year. I'm fairly sure. What decided it was seeing the cost in shekels. With my own bank I'd lose about 3,000 ₪ (לאומי, "‑3,096 ₪") to 5,000 ₪ (הפועלים, "‑5,021 ₪"), and those are real numbers. I'd still check with my own 30,000 ₪, and I'd probably open the account at פסגות first.

**Where I looked, in order:**
1. The big heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן". S&P 500 was already picked, and the example was 10,000 ₪ today, 500 a month, 10 years. The big box said "הבחירה שלכם · הזול 86,492 ₪", with "הפקדתם 70,000 ₪" next to it.
2. The two lists side by side, fund on the left and account on the right. Account: פסגות at #1 with 0 ₪. Under that came the banks with minus amounts in shekels. That's where it clicked for me.
3. The fund list. I just took the top one, the one with "הבחירה" next to it. I skipped the English iShares and Vanguard rows. Most of them said "אין מחיר כאן" and "עוד לא נאסף".
4. The table "מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם": 12 years instead of 10 gives "19,116 ₪ יותר". I didn't do anything with it.
5. "עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי" and the charts full of minuses. Didn't get it, scrolled past.
6. The steps chart, the "מנקודת ההתחלה" one. Lost me.
7. The tables at the bottom and the small print. Scrolled past.

**Words I didn't get:** "צוברת", "מחלקת דיבידנד", "נטרול מט"ח" / "מנוטרלת מט"ח", "חשיפה לדולר", "4D" and "4A", "נאמן", "דמי משמרת", "עמלת מט"ח", "W-8BEN", "סטיית מעקב" (I think that's what "מול המדד" means). Also "נקנית בחו"ל" and "סם גם על שינוי המטבע".

**Where I got stuck:**
- **The 30,000 question.** The sliders are set to 10,000 and 500 and I didn't change them. So the 86,492 isn't really my number.
- **Steps chart.** It says "עכשיו 79,176 ₪" with ירושלים. I don't know why ירושלים is "now" when the page picked פסגות.
- **פסגות twice.** In the table under the steps chart פסגות appears twice. In one column the account costs "‑5,416 ₪", in the other "+41 ₪". It made me unsure if פסגות is really free.
- **The one red-and-yellow fund.** "הראל מחקה S&P 500 (4A) מנוטרלת מט"ח" says "בין 2,212+ ₪ ל‑23,766‑ ₪". That range scared me off it.
- **Getting bored.** I got bored at the long fund list (screens 3–4). After the currency section with the minus charts I'd basically have closed the page. I just flicked to the bottom to see if there's a "what to do now".
- **Nothing to press.** No button anywhere telling me what to do first, like open an account or buy.
